code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    # The marker is the rare non-background color; the noisy field uses 0 and another color.
    marker = min((v for v in counts if v != 0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
